result.stdout:
algoctl createrepo — create a new repository from a template repository.

Usage:
    algoctl createrepo --repo <owner/repo|url> --ghuser <user> [options]

Options:
    --templaterepo <owner/repo|url>   Template repository to copy content from.
                                      Short form (owner/repo) defaults to github.com;
                                      a full URL may target a GitHub Enterprise host.
                                      Default: https://github.com/microsoft/AL-Go-PTE@preview
    --templateghuser <user>           GitHub CLI account to use for reading the
                                      template repository. Default: the active account
                                      on the template host, or unauthenticated if none.
    --repo <owner/repo|url>           The repository to create. Short form defaults
                                      to github.com. (required)
    --ghuser <user>                   GitHub CLI account to use for creating the
                                      repository. Default: the active account on the
                                      target host.
    --visibility <private|internal|public>
                                      Visibility of the new repository.
                                      Default: private
    --confirm                         Skip the interactive confirmation prompt.
    --help, -h                        Show this help.

result.stdout:
algoctl updaterepo — update an existing repository with the AL-Go system-file
update workflow from a template repository, then run that workflow.

Only the .github/workflows/UpdateGitHubGoSystemFiles.yaml file is copied; no
other content from the template is touched.

Usage:
    algoctl updaterepo --repo <owner/repo|url> --ghuser <user> [options]

Options:
    --templaterepo <owner/repo|url>   Template repository to copy the workflow from.
                                      Short form (owner/repo) defaults to github.com;
                                      a full URL may target a GitHub Enterprise host.
                                      Default: https://github.com/microsoft/AL-Go-PTE@preview
    --templateghuser <user>           GitHub CLI account to use for reading the
                                      template repository. Default: the active account
                                      on the template host, or unauthenticated if none.
    --repo <owner/repo|url>           The repository to update. Short form defaults
                                      to github.com. (required)
    --ghuser <user>                   GitHub CLI account to use for updating the
                                      repository. Default: the active account on the
                                      target host.
    --branches <list>                 Comma-separated list of branches to update, passed
                                      to the workflow's includeBranches input. Wildcards
                                      are supported. Default: main
    --confirm                         Skip the interactive confirmation prompt.
    --help, -h                        Show this help.

result.stdout:
algoctl createrelease — run the AL-Go CreateRelease.yaml workflow in an
existing repository to promote a build to a GitHub release.

Usage:
    algoctl createrelease --repo <owner/repo|url> --ghuser <user> --name <name> --tag <tag> [options]

Options:
    --repo <owner/repo|url>           The repository to create the release in. Short form
                                      defaults to github.com. (required)
    --ghuser <user>                   GitHub CLI account to use for running the workflow.
                                      Default: the active account on the target host.
    --branch <branch>                 Branch (ref) to run the workflow on.
                                      Default: the repository's default branch.
    --name <name>                     Name of this release. (required)
    --tag <tag>                       Tag of this release; must be a semantic version
                                      string (https://semver.org, e.g. 1.0.0). A pattern
                                      ending in '*' (e.g. 1.0.*) resolves to the latest
                                      matching tag with its patch incremented, or the
                                      first one (e.g. 1.0.0) when none exist. (required)
    --buildversion <version>          Build version to promote to release.
                                      Default: latest
    --releasetype <Release|Prerelease|Draft>
                                      Release, prerelease or draft? Default: Release
    --createreleasebranch             Create a release branch. Default: false
    --releasebranchprefix <prefix>    Prefix for the release branch. Used only if
                                      --createreleasebranch is set. Default: release/
    --updateversionnumber <version>   New version number in the main branch. Use
                                      Major.Minor (optionally add .Build for versioning
                                      strategy 3) for an absolute change, or +1, +0.1
    
[truncated]

result.stdout:
algoctl downloadfile — download a file from Azure Front Door (or any HTTP
server) fast, using parallel byte-range streams.
Inspired by Stefan Maron's https://github.com/StefanMaron/MsDyn365Bc.On.Linux project.

A HEAD request determines size, range support and cache state. A local
cache hit (X-Cache: TCP_HIT) uses at most 2 streams; otherwise up to
--maxthreads streams are used. Each stream retries and aborts a
connection that stalls.

Usage:
    algoctl downloadfile --url <url> --path <dest> [options]

Options:
    --url <url>                       URL of the file to download. (required)
    --path <dest>                     Destination file, or the destination directory
                                      when --unzip is set. (required)
    --maxthreads <n>                  Parallel streams on a cache miss. Default: 16
    --stallseconds <n>                Abort a stream idle this long. Default: 60
    --maxattempts <n>                 Retries per chunk. Default: 4
    --unzip                           Extract the download into --path (a directory)
                                      instead of writing the file.
    --help, -h                        Show this help.

algoctl downloadartifacts — download Business Central artifacts into a local
cache, using the same folder structure as BcContainerHelper's Download-Artifacts
(<basePath>/<type>/<version>/<country> and <basePath>/<type>/<version>/platform).

Usage:
    algoctl downloadartifacts --artifactUrl <url> [options]

Options:
    --artifactUrl <url>               URL of the artifact to download. (required)
    --includePlatform                 Also download the platform artifact.
    --force                           Download even if the artifact folder exists
                                      (the existing folder is removed first).
    --basePath <path>                 Root folder of the artifact cache.
                                      Default: /tmp/inspectra-help-algoct-ebbad0a1-b4a3b439/home/.bcartifacts.cache
    --help, -h                        Show this help.
